text: Generic ntest learnings — append via ntest learn / test-learn.sh after verified runs.
client_reference_number must be a numeric string — not Postman {{$timestamp}} literal
expected_disbursement_date null can break processors parsing epoch long — set aligned epoch ms
Use LAN from phase1 demo or scripts/scratch/dpic_demo_state.env after dpic demo phase1
BATCH APIs need op_code + job_time in request; align JOB_TIME to EOD business date epoch ms
Run after interest accrual jobs in LMS-EOD-BOD (priorities 14-16 before DPI 17-19)
Loan status / disbursement_status / DPI fields — scripts/db-local.sh --canned 01-loan-status-by-lan
Before money-path ntest: scripts/bin/kg-ensure-fresh.sh && correlators from registry _correlators or dpic_demo_state.env
